output.subject: We've received your complaint about your debit card while traveling
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for calling us while you were in Montreal and for taking the time to explain what happened. We have received your complaint, and we want to confirm the main points as you shared them with us.

You told us your debit card had been declining since that morning after a fraud alert was triggered on your hotel transaction. You mentioned that you replied "yes" to the fraud text alert twice, but your card was still declined, which understandably left you frustrated. You also asked that your debit card work for you while you are traveling.

We're sorry for the frustration and inconvenience this caused, especially while you were away from home. Not being able to rely on your card while traveling is stressful, and we appreciate you letting us know.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days. If you have any further details you would like us to consider in the meantime, please let us know.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Call note says the representative verified the transactions, removed the block and added a travel note through 9/7; decide whether to confirm this to the customer.
Confirm the card is currently working and the travel note dates match the customer's trip.
Customer's main grievance is that replying yes to the fraud text twice did not unblock the card; decide how to address this.
The representative's explanation about text reply delays is partly obscured in the note (a redacted token appears where a time unit would be); verify what the customer was told before referencing it.
Note records no fees and no disputed transactions; confirm before sending.
Customer may still be traveling; consider whether a faster contact is appropriate.
